title: A part with only a -2 bin shows -2 and -$20 and lowers the totals
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Every part in this case is tracked and costs $10.00 per unit.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-NEG-01) is active at {Location-A}, with -2 in its only bin {Bin-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-NEG-02) is active at {Location-A}, with 4 in its only bin {Bin-A}.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-NEG-).
  • Line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET NEGATIVE ONLY") of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) took 2 of {Part-A} from {Bin-A} while {Bin-A} held 0, which put {Bin-A} at -2.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Reports and open the Inventory Value report.
  2. Leave the as-of date on today.
  3. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  4. Type {Prefix-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the rows listed (Qty, Unit Cost and Total Cost).
  6. Read the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-A} is listed (not left out) with Qty -2.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost -$20.00 (-2 × $10.00). {Part-B} is listed with Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00.
  • Step 6: Totals reads Qty 2.00 and Total Cost $20.00 (4 + (-2) = 2; $40.00 + (-$20.00) = $20.00). It does not read 4.00 and $40.00, which would mean the negative part was left out.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §2 Accounting, read 13 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

  • SV-10380 expected behavior: “Include negative-quantity parts with their signed values.”
  • SV-10380 reproduction table: “-2 only | Omitted / $0 contribution | -2 / -$20”
